file_reviews.assessment: Audited Paper 004 Section 4 (serialization distinctions and PacketCodec scope), Section 5 (restricted host execution, input bindings, and admission refusals), and Section 7 (governor native dispatch and CUT completeness).

Audited claim rows P4-04 (admission refusals on four-vertex fixture), P4-09 (PacketCodec NFC normalization and verify scope), P4-15 (governor native dispatch and float/bool refusal), and P4-17 (CUT completeness refusal and atomic non-mutation).
Audited compute_phi1 exact rational enumeration, absence of native fallback, float/bool weight refusals, and step_cut IncompleteProposal guards with atomic state preservation.
Audited test_cut_omitting_a_declared_edge_is_refused, test_cut_with_a_non_exact_value_is_refused, and test_complete_explicit_proposal_is_still_scored with state equality checks.
Audited PacketCodec NFC normalization, canonical tagged JSON bytes generation, payload SHA-256 matching, authority_effect 'None' check, and scope limitation to local envelope verification.
Audited face_aware_coda_crosses_exact_host_but_global_admission_stays_refused emitting exactly PRIME000_CONFORMANCE_PARTIAL and UNSIGNED_LAB_ATTESTATION codes.

claims.statement: Without a native executable the governor uses exact Python enumeration; with one, native refusals and errors propagate; float/bool weights are refused on both paths.
dependencies: ConstraintGraph and Cochain1 exact discrete rational representation in l1_symbol_game_governor.py.
Strict propagation of native execution failures without Python fallback masking.
Refusal of non-exact numeric types (float, bool) on all evaluation paths.
claims.limits: Applies to the discrete l1 graph governor; exact enumeration results are evaluated over finite discrete potential spaces and do not constitute native binary attestation.

claims.statement: step_cut refuses a CUT omitting a declared edge or with a non-exact value (IncompleteProposal, state unchanged).
dependencies: Domain completeness requirement verifying that proposed_claims covers every edge in ConstraintGraph.edges.
Exact type checking refusing float and bool proposed claim values.
Atomic rollback ensuring governor internal state remains unmodified upon refusal.
claims.limits: Applies to relational CUT proposal validation; acceptance of an exact complete proposal indicates formal graph defect satisfaction, not external factual truth.

claims.statement: PacketCodec applies NFC and tagged encoding; verify checks only payload digest and authority.
dependencies: Unicode NFC normalization in _normalize_unicode preventing key collisions.
Tagged canonical byte encoding preserving exact type distinctions.
Verification scope bounded to payload SHA-256 match and authority_effect == 'None'.
claims.limits: Applies to PacketCodec transport envelope integrity; does not perform cryptographic producer signing or full-protocol lifecycle gating.

claims.statement: With the fixture outcome, admission is refused with exactly the partial-conformance and unsigned-attestation codes.
dependencies: Restricted host execution evaluating four-vertex fixture to exact lab evidence status.
Global admission gating refusing entry into production state on partial conformance and unsigned attestation.
claims.limits: Applies to the audited four-vertex test fixture; admission refusal establishes fail-closed boundary enforcement, not global non-admissibility across all possible requests.
